description: Geocode up to 100 US addresses in a single call and return each one's match status, standardized address, coordinates, and state/county/tract/block FIPS codes. Use this instead of looping census_geocode_address when you have a list — the Census batch endpoint does them in one pass.

addresses.description: List of addresses (max 100). Each item is either a one-line string, or an object with street/city/state/zip and an optional id.

id.description: Your own identifier, echoed back on the result row

name: census_geocode_batch
